# Pacman arcade design system — retro tokens, sprites and UX specs

Curated by Skill Harbor — @bergside's Pacman skill from the awesome-design-skills series: a complete retro design system for building arcade-style interfaces in the Pacman universe. Ships design tokens (colors, typography scale, spacing, border radius, effects), a full color palette, SVG sprites for the Pacman character, ghosts and game elements, component patterns (arcade buttons, score displays, cards, panels), page templates, UX specs, and accessibility guidance — reduced-motion and high-contrast support, keyboard navigation, screen-reader-safe retro aesthetics. Honest caveats: all character names and designs reference the copyrighted Pac-Man IP — fan/fan-tribute works are the realistic use case, don't ship commercial Pac-Man-branded products from this; the sprite assets are referenced from the repo's assets directory. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
